source.name: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division: State Minimum Wage Laws

scheduleSources.name: Florida Constitution, Article X, Section 24 (Amendment 2, 2020): $15.00 on September 30, 2026
Hivedesk: Minimum Wage by State 2026 (scheduled and announced increases, September 18, 2026)
First HR: Minimum Wage Increases by State (September 28, 2026)
Presence News: California and Connecticut to raise minimum wage over $17 an hour (August 6, 2026)

notes: Rates are the basic state rate per hour from the DOL table. Where a state rate is below the federal rate, or the state has no law, the federal rate applies to employers covered by the FLSA. Local minimums (for example Seattle, SeaTac, Denver or parts of California) can be higher than the state rate and are not included. 'next' lists a change only when it is set in law or was announced, with the source noted in scheduleSources.

jurisdictions.name: District of Columbia
